steps.content: [Hella's Dream]
Consciousness drifts in the darkness.

Trapped in an endless nightmare, she watches the Black Ring bleed into existence once again. That jagged halo of crimson once swallowed the sky above Syndicate, leaving her loved ones torn apart, while she was too weak to save them.
[Flashback: Rustfire CG and Dialogue]
Emotions long buried surge forth like a tide of blackened sludge, dragging her down, drowning her in the depths of her own dread.
The fear, the crushing helplessness—they never truly left. She had only locked them away, buried them where they festered.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Black Ring's gonna blow any second. That idiot threw herself in just to get me out... I can't stop it now, but someone's gotta know what's happening! I have to do something... What else can I do now?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on, stupid brain, work!! Everyone's gonna die if you don't figure this out!!
She wants to become stronger. She must. Because...

steps.speaker: Girl's Voice
steps.content: I understand. I'll wait for you to become stronger, for you to come back...

steps.speaker: Girl's Voice
steps.content: Hella, that's a promise.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}, Hecate, Ninety-Nine...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Without you guys here... "becoming stronger" feels so impossible...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There's just... so much I can't handle alone. No matter how hard I push myself, no matter how strong I get... some things just don't work out. Some people... I just can't save.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Feels like I'm the only one who's still this useless... who can't do anything...
Bang!
As if a hard kick landed on her rear, her anger and frustration are instantly booted away, replaced by that infuriating, ever-grinning voice in her ear.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Silly, you said you had to play hero all by yourself? Ever considered ganging up on your enemies?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I've left you all the goodies I've been stashing away. Make sure they don't go to waste, okay?
[Waking Up] [Refugee Camp - Overcast]

June 24, N.F. 115
1:56 PM
Refugee Settlement, Outside the Aurum Secretum Institute

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella? You finally woke up!
The world slowly sharpens into focus as two worried faces hover above her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Horo? When did you get out... No, wait, how long has it been? I—
Then, the pain crashes in. Every muscle screams in protest, her wounds burn as if seared by fire, and her throat is so parched it cracks when she tries to speak.

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Careful! ...Does it still hurt? When I found you, you were burning up all over! Your throat must feel all scratchy and dry...

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Wait here, I'll go get some more water.
Thani rises and leaves. Hella coughs, her gaze drifting over her surroundings—she's lying in a tent in the refugee camp, wrapped in what seems to be the tent's only blanket.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The contamination in your body is bad. Just stay down, and don't try to move. Whatever's going on, it can wait.
A scorching hand seizes Horo's arm. Hella's voice is raw, barely more than a whisper, yet she grits her teeth and speaks.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I have... have to tell you now...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: At the center of the maze, the danger Synex mentioned... Horo, you were right...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I saw the inheritance. They're going to set off a Black Ring! Synex is ground zero. They're dragging everyone down with them!!
[Change Perspective: Outside Refugee Camp]

The sky hangs heavy with clouds. Without warning, a squad of guards bursts into the refugee camp. The refugees shrink back, pressing into the shadows, their hushed whispers laced with surprise and confusion.

steps.speaker: Uriel
steps.content: The screening officers? But they were just here yesterday...

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: You there, where are the Furorians who arrived recently?
The visitors clearly mean trouble. Uriel tenses, but his voice stays steady, testing the waters with careful words.

steps.speaker: Uriel
steps.content: Furorians? Didn't they get taken to the institute their first day here...? Who are you looking for, exactly?

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: This is an order from above! Two DisCity people were hiding among the refugees, and now they're gone. You see them, you report them immediately. No hiding fugitives, got it?
Chaos erupts. Behind the clamoring crowd, a figure slips through the shadows, quickly darting in the opposite direction.
[Perspective shifts back to Hella]

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: How could this happen? Then... does that mean everyone who got picked before is...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I tried to stop them, but I was too weak... Synex was the one who threw me out...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We're running out of time! We have to move... now!
The wounds Mania carved into her refuse to heal, their pain a constant tremor in her muscles. Another wave of dizziness crashes over her, but Hella grits her teeth and forces herself to stay upright.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I'm so useless.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I said I'd get stronger. Left MBCC to prove I could handle the real world... but look at me. Still just a screw-up...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: All I do is run my mouth. "Rat Queen of Syndicate"? Heh, just a dumb title to make dumbasses think I'm scary. But when it actually mattered? Got my ass handed to me, like always...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Synex is still trapped with those freaks... and if they set off the Black Ring, it'll be... just like last time...
A soft pat brushes Hella's back, then the scratchy warmth of the blanket settles over her. It's Horo. With surprising tenderness, she guides Hella down, cocooning her in layers of fabric.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hey... take it easy. Stay down and just listen for a sec.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: After we got separated, we were stuck in that damn maze. Couldn't reach you, couldn't find an exit.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: But at least the enemy numbers didn't keep piling up. Then, a few hours ago, some kind of disturbance hit... and most of the maze just collapsed. That's when I saw you staggering out of the wreckage...
Through the haze of fever and fabric, Hella feels arms wrap around her—steady and gentle. Horo's voice reaches her, muffled and distant, words dissolving in the fog of her mind.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...This isn't your fault. We're the ones who came too late.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Charging in alone to dig up the truth? That took real guts. You're already braver than most.

Hella curls tighter, fingers clutching the blankets as a sob tears free. The thick layers swallow the sound, but her shoulders shake anyway. Horo's hand moves in slow circles on her back, a silent pact to ignore the tears.
But the moment of peace doesn't last long. Commotion erupts outside, and the tent flap whips open with a violent snap as someone stumbles inside.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: —They're here! The institute's sweeping the camp, and they'll get here any minute. You need to go, now!

Sure enough, the commotion draws closer. There's no time to wait for her wounds to heal; they have to move now. Hella feels the blankets tighten around her as strong hands haul her upright, urgency in every motion.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Thani told me you got into the institute...
A voice thick with suppressed emotion reaches her ears. It takes Hella several seconds to register who's speaking.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Did you see my boy?

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Is he... still alive?
[Flashback: Small CG - Small Alchemic Beast]
...Mo... Mom?
[Back to Reality]
Of course she saw him. But Hella doesn't know how to answer this desperate mother.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I saw him. At the institute.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He... told me the Fraser people are researching something really, really dangerous. The whole screening process and the Aurum Secretum are all just a front. Everyone they drag into that facility... they're just... sacrifices. For them to get Hypercubes...
Her throat tight and dry, Hella forces out the words she must say.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And then he... he insisted on staying behind. Said he has to keep fighting those bastards. So...s...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...He's not coming back. Not yet.
The woman's grip tightens on Hella's arm, hard enough to border on pain. Her voice trembles.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Thank you... Right, he's always so brave, so kind... I...

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Sob...
The back of Hella's hand grows damp with tears. In this moment, any comfort feels hollow.
The clamor draws nearer, but the figure ahead halts abruptly.
Without anyone noticing, a crowd of refugees has gathered at the entrance. Their eyes lock onto the DisCity interlopers inside the tent, faces unreadable.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Damn it...!

As time slips away, she can already hear the guards' shouts edging closer. There's no time to explain everything to the refugees. Should she force her way through? Horo's hand reaches back toward her weapon, but she stalls, gripped by hesitation.
Someone makes the first move.
A refugee sheds their cloak, flinging it over Hella and Horo. Others surge forward, swallowing them into the crowd as it funnels toward the camp's exit.
Hella jerks her head up in surprise, only to find a pale and strained face. Sandra offers her a thin, forced smile.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: You helped our family in Furor. That makes you our friend.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Let's go. I'll help you get out of here.
